Name: Haley and Penny Universal Love
Author: LisaWolf
Description:
Just a really simple mod that changes the NPCGiftTastes file so Penny will love rabbits feet and Haley will love Prism Shards. Made it more for myself because I kept messing up which gift to give them.

Just install it into the Stardew Valley\Conent\Data folder.

If you want to uninstall it later be sure to backup original version before install it.
